title: Establish the consumer contract before writing a failing regression
applies_when: A formatting, validation, model-config, shape, resource-budget, backend-support or uninitialized-local allegation relies on partial source rather than the actual producer and consumer.
lesson: Trace allocation, transformations, enclosing guards and every consumer before inventing a regression. Later assignments can overwrite values. Check Python walrus assignments: a clipped branch cannot establish absence of a prior binding. Distinguish instance/host labels and request/token counts. Intersect fallback triggers with native launch constraints before huge reproductions. Fabricated metadata or accepted shape/dtype does not prove a reachable empty/sentinel-only path. For config helpers, exercise the real subtype getter; generic base fixtures can lose nested routing. Missing validation or a changed assertion does not establish backend support. Require a supported caller and observable native failure before environment repair or publication.
avoid_when: Reachable malformed inputs can be defects. A rank-zero scalar has one element, not zero storage. Fragment-only readers may be valid while a later full-tensor overflow check sees stale scratch; trace reuse and reproduce corruption through a real prior operation and finite training step, not arbitrary poisoning. Callback stand-ins must preserve transformations: RoPE+SDPA can return BHSD from BSHD unlike plain SDPA. Error wording may have a documented contract. Static source or extracted-function checks refute only the specific claim, not native/GPU/general correctness. Metadata-only section stresses are not supported checkpoint/kernel witnesses. External or dynamic callers may remain unobserved.

evidence.note: mrope_num_dims consults config.get_text_config before the outer object. A generic base-config fixture does not establish the behavior of a native composite subtype.
Qwen2_5OmniConfig delegates get_text_config through its thinker config. Preserve that routing; this source is not inference or universal Omni coverage.
Enclosing if cfg := mambaish_config(...) binds cfg before hybrid reads; fallback rebinds it. Extracted-function/stub checks are not GPU execution or supported-model integration.
Without the explicit SGLANG_HICACHE_HOST_MEMORY_BYTES override, min(host available, cgroup headroom) caps the result despite a v1 unlimited sentinel. Static invariant only.
Real NaN-to-finite DP2 regression reports old failures and four B300 passes (BF16/FP16 masters, FP32 controls). Review/CI, convergence and performance unproven.
Restoration updates only the owned fragment in reused scratch, then clones a full view. Inspect full-gradient overflow and reset lifetime, not fragment readers alone.
Expert registration overwrites matching dense mesh entries; unmatched dimensions alone do not prove a supported failure.
Adapter dense/expert dimension names match; a mismatched-mesh regression needs another caller.
All-invalid q2k can divide by zero, but shipped builders require full edges/fixed geometry. Assertion changes are not empty-route support.
Small-token guard precedes a >2046 MiB fallback; ordering alone is not a supported-input failure.
16-byte accesses, <=8-block clusters and <=1024 threads constrain ranks 2/4/8/16 with token_num<=world_size to <=32 MiB. Refutes the fallback-hang premise, not collective correctness.
CLI choices reach argparse; plugins are permitted. CUSTOM fallback alone does not prove typo acceptance; programmatic callers are separate.
DNS-SD instance labels permit non-control punctuation and at most 63 octets; protocol fact, not an application measurement.
The standard distinguishes service instance labels from hostnames and their restrictions.
One normalizer serves host labels and instances; an instance trailing hyphen alone does not prove an invalid zone. Overrides/resolvers remain separate.
Capture sets metadata_rows=num_tokens; replay uses sequence_lengths.numel(). Refutes request-count sizing for initialized capture, not GPU correctness.
Comment excludes B_K=128; registered ids 1400-1404/6400-6404 use B_K=64. Their removal is not justified by that comment.
Padded A/B sizes: registered B_K=64 needs 66-148.5 KiB (<160); excluded B_K=128 needs 165/231. Source arithmetic, not HIP/GPU execution.
Raw-verify leaves extend_seq_lens=None; minimum creates a tensor before clamp_min_. Fabricated non-None metadata is not corruption proof; other setters unverified. Tensor.to alone need not copy.
Constructor assigns lower_bound. Later getattr/direct reads do not prove it missing; fabricated objects are not supported-path evidence.

Base prepare_load_back returns True; shared-SWA override computes/reclaims without offset debit; reserve debits after admission. Inspect overrides, not first-symbol windows. Reclaim/eviction and GPU correctness remain separate.
